articles.summary: Adient marked the 30th anniversary of its business in China with a celebration Sept. 22 at the China Tech Center in Chongqing. Jerome Dorlack, president and CEO; Heather Tiltmann, chief legal and HR officer and corporate secretary; James Huang, executive vice president, APAC; and members of the APAC and China leadership teams and employee representatives...
articles.title: Adient celebrates 30 years of leadership in China
